defect: the generated clock declares divide_by 4 for a divide_by 8 prescaler
rationale: count_q[2] changes state every four clk_i edges and has a rising edge every eight reference cycles. The constraint declares divide_by 4, making the slow_clk period half its actual value.

mutation.description: Declared slow_clk with divide_by 4 although the retained prescaler output is clk_i divided by 8.

author: gpt-5.6-luna

provenance.adaptation: Retained the generic even-divider counter and a register on the divided clock; removed dynamic step-down and primitive clock wrappers.

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: slow_clk is bit 2 of a free-running counter, divide by 8, but constrained divide_by 4.
